name: kosmo-sdlc
description: Deterministic, gated SDLC loop for full-stack JavaScript projects. Turns a ticket into a merged PR through intake → implement → validate → review → PR → revalidate, with a single track file as source of truth.

metadata.description: A portable Claude Code plugin that codifies a track-driven SDLC cycle

plugins.name: kosmo-sdlc
plugins.description: Nine slash commands (/kosmo-sdlc:init, /kosmo-sdlc:intake, /kosmo-sdlc:implement, /kosmo-sdlc:validate, /kosmo-sdlc:review, /kosmo-sdlc:pr, /kosmo-sdlc:pr-comments, /kosmo-sdlc:revalidate, /kosmo-sdlc:cycle) that turn a ticket into a merged PR with gated phases and a machine-readable track file.
